Cross-cutting statement of the document for the Appointment, Recall and Referral criteria screens - recorded once here (Referral Production List); it applies to every report of this category that has the Office / Office Group radios.
dynamic_rules.evidence_quote: `Office` = one or more offices; `Office Group` = groups from setup.

corrections.text: PROCEDURE DATE RANGE is the period of the posted procedures that are counted.
corrections.evidence_quote: `PROCEDURE DATE RANGE` | Period of the posted procedures counted.

corrections.text: FIRST VISIT DATE RANGE restricts the report to patients whose first visit falls in the range (a new-patient cohort); left blank, all patients are included, as the section title says.
corrections.evidence_quote: Restricts to patients whose first visit falls in the range (new-patient cohort).

corrections.text: ZIP CODE RANGE From / Through filter on the patient's zip code.
REFERRAL TYPE is a single choice: one referral type or ALL.
Group By Zip Code switches the report to its by-zip-code variant - the former report Referral Production Listing by Zipcode.
corrections.evidence_quote: `Referral Production Listing by Zipcode` | `Referral Production List` → `Group By Zip Code`

corrections.text: Vendor text describes the report as single-office and current-state: the data is limited to the office the report is run in, for patients currently in that office, with no cross-office data (history is lost when the patient's office or referral changes). How that limit works together with the Office / Office Group picker of the criteria screen is not stated (see unresolved).
corrections.evidence_quote: Data is limited to the office the report is run in, for patients currently in that office; no cross-office

corrections.text: The report reads the single Referred To field of the patient record, so one patient is one referral; REFERRAL OUT TO is read by the document as a filter on that referred-to referral source. (The document presumes - unverified - that referral cases created with the Refer To workflow are reported by the Referral Management reports instead.)
corrections.evidence_quote: Reads the single `Referred To` field of the patient record `[P64]`, so one patient = one referral

corrections.text: The greyed OFFICE/GROUP section (both radios and the SELECT button) is by design: it is disabled in the vendor's own screenshot of this screen too, because referral sources are organisation-wide.
corrections.evidence_quote: The disabled `OFFICE/GROUP` section is by design.

corrections.text: REFERRED TO/BY filters the sources on their Referred by/To setting (in referral-source setup: Referred By / Referred To / Both); the report footer echoes the choice as a code, 99 standing for all. The option labels of the dropdown itself are not documented (see unresolved).

The eight specific status checkboxes of the grid (Accepted, Rejected, Pending, Cancelled, Completed, In Progress, Not Needed, Expired) carry exactly the labels of the vendor's fixed status vocabulary of a referral case - Pending is the default status of a new case and Expired is set automatically after 30 days. The vocabulary has no further value, so another status checkbox below the third row is unlikely; whether anything else follows the grid is still unknown (see unresolved). The vocabulary is documented for the Referral Management utility: that the checkboxes filter the Referral Status of the case is the expected reading, and no vendor screenshot shows the criteria of this report.
corrections.evidence_quote: Referral cases have a fixed status vocabulary:** `Pending` (default), `Accepted`, `Rejected`, `In Progress`,

corrections.text: PROCEDURE DATE RANGE is applied to the posted procedures.

PROCEDURE DATE RANGE is the period in which the referred patients were seen: the report counts, per referral source, the referred patients seen in the period. What exactly counts as seen is unverified (see unresolved).
corrections.evidence_quote: count of referred patients seen in the period

corrections.text: Build history: this is the newest report of the category - the external-incoming referral feature it reports on dates from 2023. The vendor's June 2023 screenshot of the Referral Reports list shows seven reports, without External Incoming Referral Management; our 2026 capture has eight.
corrections.evidence_quote: `External Incoming Referral Management` was added after June 2023.
